addresses.description: List of address object. See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

emails.description: List of the email object. See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

additionalProperties.description: Name object. See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

name.description: Name object. See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

origin.description:
WhatsApp inbound only
Indicates how the contact was shared by the user. contact_request means the contact was shared in direct response to a REQUEST_CONTACT_INFO button; other means the contact was shared organically (e.g. a forwarded vCard). Present only on inbound contact messages when supplied by WhatsApp; omitted when absent. Not encrypted for client-side encryption.

additionalProperties.description: See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

org.description: See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

phones.description: List of the phone object. See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

urls.description: List of the url object. See request example WhatsApp Contacts: One message

profileName.description: Users profile name as set up on their WA Client

userId.description: Business-Scoped User ID (BSUID) of the WhatsApp user. Format: CC.alphanumeric (max 131 chars). Always present for WhatsApp messages. Not encrypted for client-side encryption.

parentUserId.description: Parent BSUID for linked business portfolios. Format: CC.ENT.alphanumeric (max 135 chars). Present only if your company is an eligible enterprise explicitly enrolled in a Parent BSUID account. Not encrypted for client-side encryption.

username.description: WhatsApp username handle. Present only if the user has enabled a username. Encrypted for client-side encryption.
